old_problem: The earlier review left scope/normalization pending because `all data` could mean the literal service-root response or an entire linked graph; grep also reports no match on retrieval failure and loses complete evidence.
disposition_reason: The source command unambiguously fetches exactly `/redfish/v1`, so ED-20 requires preserving that identity rather than silently expanding to a crawl. The literal response body is the authoritative scope; raw bytes plus decoded keys/values/URIs are scanned for exact `Wistron` and case-folded variants. Broader graph policy is optional project configuration, not a review blocker.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2253 and 2254, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record and unique identity were reviewed.
Bind scope to the successful `/redfish/v1` response body named by the Procedure; do not infer linked-resource traversal.
Require verified TLS, successful JSON response, complete raw bytes/hash and duplicate/encoding validation before any negative result.
Scan pre-redaction raw body and all decoded JSON keys, string values and URIs for literal and Unicode case-folded `Wistron`; report exact paths/offsets.
A retrieval, authentication, truncation, parse or encoding error is ERROR/BLOCKED, never a zero-match PASS.

test_case.purpose: Prove the complete literal Redfish service-root representation contains no `Wistron` branding, with reproducible negative evidence rather than a grep/no-output shortcut.
required_package: JSON duplicate/encoding-aware parser and raw-byte scanner
Optional project additions for forbidden variants/exceptions or broader graph scope
test_case.test_command: Issue one TLS-validated secret-safe GET to `/redfish/v1`; preserve status/headers/raw-body hash, require successful complete unique-key JSON, scan raw bytes plus decoded keys/string values/URIs for exact and case-folded `Wistron`, and emit a searched-path/byte manifest.
test_case.expected_result: The service-root GET succeeds with complete valid JSON and the pre-redaction raw and structured scans find zero unapproved occurrences of `Wistron`; any match is reported with exact location/context.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires successful complete retrieval, valid JSON, a complete scan manifest and zero literal/case-folded matches in the service-root body. Any match is FAIL unless an explicitly approved exception applies. Retrieval/parse/truncation ambiguity is BLOCKED/ERROR, not PASS.
safety_gate: GET only and scan before redaction.
Keep transport errors separate from body data.
Do not crawl linked resources unless separately configured and bounded.
expected_evidence: Raw body/hash and JSON duplicate/encoding result
Raw and structured path/field scan manifest
Zero matches or every match/exception disposition
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected; on transport or parsing failure preserve the partial/error evidence and stop without echoing a clean result or changing metadata.
